credentials.description: license key, sent as Authorization: Basic <license key> (the key as is, not base64 of user:password)
website ID of your LengoPay account, sent with the request (body field websiteid, or path segment for get_balance), separate from the license key

websiteId.description: Unique site identifier (Site ID in the LengoPay dashboard). Embedded in the path.

balance.description: Account balance as a numeric string (e.g. "7792").

gotchas: balance is returned as a string (e.g. "7792"), not a number — use parseFloat(balance) before any calculation.
The URL has no /v1/ prefix, unlike the other LengoPay endpoints (e.g. /api/getbalance/ and not /api/v1/getbalance/).
